title: Egyptian-Style Chicken Kebabs
description: Marinated chicken kebabs with an Egyptian twist, grilled to perfection with a side of exotic spices. This dish is inspired by Italian cuisine and the rich flavors of the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: Exotic spices
ingredients.notes: such as berbere or ras el hanout

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken, eggplant, bell peppers, and onion, and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated vegetables and chicken onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Brush the kebabs with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
